verdict.rationale: Sandboxes can run continuously for hours, up to 24 hours on Pro but only 1 hour on Base, and the timeout can be extended at runtime with setTimeout/set_timeout. Multi-day work is handled by pause and resume, which keeps filesystem, memory and processes, and paused sandboxes are kept indefinitely. However, nothing executes while a sandbox is paused, so a single session cannot keep running for days. Missing for 10: continuous runtime beyond 24 hours, long sessions on the Base plan, and independent or hands-on corroboration of long-running sessions.
